modmenu.descriptionTranslation.floatingd: Adds floating damage numbers above every target you hit, and your own incoming damage too. Color-coded by damage type.
floatingdamageindicators.config.title: Floating Damage Indicators
floatingdamageindicators.config.server_s: In multiplayer this is controlled by the server's config.
floatingdamageindicators.config.color_hi: Hex color in #RRGGBB format. Invalid values restore the default.
floatingdamageindicators.config.prefix_h: Up to 32 characters. Control characters restore the default.
floatingdamageindicators.config.instant_: In multiplayer, the server decides whether instant-kill messages are sent.
floatingdamageindicators.config.reset_fo: This restores colors, prefixes and options for every damage type to their defaults. The general toggles are not changed.
floatingdamageindicators.config.open_con: Edit colors, prefixes and per-type options in the config file.
